Frozen generated-geometry situation fixture (Blender workbench export, program
revision 1) used by `situation.rs`'s transaction test. A copy of the
native-migration qualification fixture with its workstation `file://` roots
rewritten to `file:///workspace/`. Values derived from the rewritten program
were recomputed: `fixture.json`'s two `baseDigest`s (situation digests) and
`geometry-binding.json`'s `patchSha256` (content hash of the geometry patch).
Artifact `sha256` values are of file bytes and are unchanged.
